setup_byol_package: run setup.py to install the byol package with pip for Bootstrap Your Own Latents training
install_byol_dependencies: install byol dependencies including jax, dm-haiku, optax, chex, and tensorflow via pip
configure_byol_package: configure the byol package with setuptools using byol_experiment, eval_experiment, and main_loop modules
build_byol_wheel: build a pip wheel for the byol package containing configs and utils subpackages
review_setup_py: review the setup.py to understand byol package dependencies and module structure
